title: chore(objectui): move the console pin to 7578323a544e (objectui#12200) (#15204 C9)
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: no

**The console pin hop `9646e2ed2bf3` → `7578323a544e`** (objectui `main`, `7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21`, exactly that commit). This hop exists for objectui#12200 (`a491b64a6`): the `position-ref` grant picker on Setup's user page stops offering the audience anchors `everyone` and `guest`, which no grant can name. This is the open finding #22967 and #23018 carried.

**Tier:** no governed surface (`GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`). 20 files, the same shape as #23018.

## The hop: 25 objectui commits, 288 paths, all on objectui `main`

Among them: `a491b64a6` (objectui#12200, the reason for this hop); `38bb37333` (objectui#12201: app identity moves into the top bar); `7578323a5` (objectui#12198: a page route's breadcrumb drops the 「Pages」 crumb); `f5b66bf97` (objectui#12217: an empty gallery draws the grid empty state); `334f0cff9` (objectui#12191: `mailto:` through one navigation-target answer); `6fb281d64` (objectui#12163: a widget's `component` envelope takes a `metric-card` only); `b2316074a` (objectui#12156: file / image size limit is `maxSize`); `54159d329` (objectui#12187: the boot screen's one honest line); `fa778e67f` (objectui#12190: a locked tier mark instead of a paywall button); and 16 more fixes, CI and docs commits, listed in the console changeset.

## The pin round, as #23018's

**Console Pin Gate steps, run locally** (each exited 0):
1. Client build: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...`.
2. `scripts/build-console.sh` at the pin.
3. `check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@7578323a544e)".
4. `check:console-injection --require-stamp`.

**Artefacts that travel with the pin:**
- **Console changeset.** `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` generated `.changeset/console-7578323a544e.md`: `@objectstack/console` **minor** (the level the script derived and the one #23018 used). It has 29 releasing entries, 2 release-nothing and 2 commits with no changeset (listed by subject). `Clause-②: no` was added by hand, as in #23018.
  - **New this hop: 5 entries are breaking by their authors' annotation** (none declares `major`, and no commit subject carries `!`). So the script wrote an `adr-0087: TODO` placeholder. It is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, the disposition every earlier pin hop with annotated breaking entries used (#22592, #22015, #22812, #22874). Each entry is answered against this tree:
    - objectui#12198 and objectui#12190 retire `@object-ui/i18n` pack keys, and #12190 also renames a test id. Nothing here reads either key or the old test id.
    - objectui#12163 narrows a widget `component` envelope that `@objectstack/spec` already refuses (`QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS`); no example dashboard authors `component` or `data`.
    - objectui#12156 makes `maxSize` the one spelling, which `FieldSchema` already declares; no example or package authors any old key.
    - objectui#12187 retires boot-splash pack keys and changes the splash line; this repo's two splash readers already accept both lines and the `data-boot-splash` marker.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` reads the disposition; `check:objectui-changeset` passes.
- **SDUI manifest.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical across the hop (107 components), and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is re-recorded at the pin. `check-sdui-manifest` passes.
- **Lockstep record.** `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` re-records `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` at `7578323a544e`. objectui's `packages/sdui-parser/src` is byte-identical across this hop; `check:sdui-lockstep` passes (214 grammar lines, 25 codes, the predicate). **No parser port is owed.**
- **Pin citations, re-measured for this hop only:**
  - Every objectui file named in every asserting record was resolved at the pin and checked with `git diff --quiet 9646e2ed2bf3 7578323a544e -- <path>`, one file at a time. Bare names were resolved by context; the only changed candidate among them, app-shell's `ObjectView.tsx`, is named only in the `kanban` record's history.
  - **Three cited files changed; every cited line held its text, and the moved ones are re-pointed:**
    - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (+34/−79, objectui#12217). One import line was added at `:16` and a four-line docblock near `:1040`; the other hunks change lines in place (`:10`, `:12`, `:1044`) or sit at `:5677` and below.
      - The `kanban` / `calendar` / `timeline` / `gantt` / `map` / `tree` arms moved +5 (`3767` / `3818` / `3907` / `3964` / `4084` / `4125-4149`).
      - `resolveListMapConfig` moved `:209` → `:210`, `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING` `:95` → `:96` and `resolveTimelineDateBinding` `695` → `696`.
      - Each moved span is byte-identical (`diff` of the old and new ranges is empty).
      - Hand-written sentences went into the functional-completeness `calendar` / `gantt` / `timeline` / `map` rows, the `object-gantt` and flat-`TreeConfig` records, and the map-config record in `view.zod.ts`. That last record is a dated "RE-READ at pin" record that `--verify-anchors` caught: its two quoted anchors were one line off, and both are re-pointed. The tree record's `4120-4144` is re-pointed too.
    - `core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` (+39/−23, objectui#12191). Eleven import lines were added above `composeSuccessMessage`, which moved `1498` → `1509` with its body byte-identical. The `outcomeMessages` record re-points its anchor, and it and the `action-outcome-messages.test.ts` header say so. The four action renderers are byte-identical.
    - The `en` / `zh` / `de` packs: the `calendar.configRequired` strings did not change and moved `en` `:949` → `:953`, `zh` `:725` → `:726`, `de` `:705` → `:706`.
  - Every other record (31 by script with asserts, plus the curated-blocks, action-group and `FormField.span` records) cites only byte-identical files, and each gains a hop sentence.
  - The six migration entries were recounted with `git grep -o -F`, which reproduces every `9646e2ed2bf3` figure. The corpus is 8600 files, and a superset of every export and key each entry names reads 0 (unrelated `Span` 519 / `SpanSchema` 57, unchanged). Controls moved, e.g. `objectstack` 18438 → 18552, `timeout` 1707 → 1686, `tenant` 1393 → 1404.
  - `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors`: 55 asserting citations match `7578323a5`, and 13 quoted anchors verify. `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` was regenerated by the build (the describe's pin stamp, two rows).
  - Changeset `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-7578323a544e.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

## Browser check, against this branch's built console

`examples/app-showcase` was booted `--fresh` (Playwright, Chromium). The walled run used the same local, uncommitted harness as #23018: the `@objectstack/organizations` dependency, plus `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`. Both files were reverted afterwards, and neither is in this diff.

- **`position-ref` (objectui#12200)**, under `single`, as the operator, on a user's Positions tab: the picker lists **15** positions, and **neither `everyone` nor `guest` is offered** (#23018 measured 17, with both). Picking `auditor` and pressing Create wrote the grant (`POST /data/sys_user_position` → 201, confirmed via the data API). `permission-ref` is unchanged: 18 sets, and `showcase_auditor` was written (201).
- **Walled catalog pages (`isolated`, served `degradedTenancy: false`).** The tenant holds org-scoped `manage_metadata`, has `isPlatformAdmin: false`, and gets a server 403 on `PUT /meta/position`. On position / permission-set lists and editors it sees no New / Save / Clone and the walled reasons (`catalog-readonly-reason`, `walled-catalog-readonly-banner`, `perm-walled-readonly`). The operator gets New, Save and an editable position editor, and a label edit auto-saved (`PUT /meta/position/wall_demo_pos?mode=draft` → 200). Unchanged from #23018.
- **App identity in the top bar (`38bb37333`)**, on the showcase app and on Setup: the app pill (glyph, name, chevron) sits at the left edge, the platform mark is gone and PREVIEW sits beside search, the Studio entry reads "Edit app", and the sidebar has no logo header. The page breadcrumb goes app › page with no 「Pages」 crumb (objectui#12198). No page errors.

## Verification (local)

- full `turbo run build` green (74/74, none cached); `check:generated` green;
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 125 derived families. The sweep was running when this draft opened, and its verdict follows in a comment, as on #23018.
